podcast.title: Culmination with DJ Shadow's Endtroducing.....
podcast.body: DJ Shadow's 1996 album, *Endtroducing.....*, is seen as a culminating point in the musical development process of instrumental hip hop. From a conceptual standpoint, the genre reached a climax with this album, with its evolution becoming notably less pronounced afterward, almost marking an end to a particular path rather than a beginning. "Posiblemente el disco de día y sado es el disco que termina todo el proceso de desarrollo musical del hip hop, como que a partir de ese disco conceptualmente el hip hop instrumental llega a un punto climax y a partir de ahí evoluciona muy poco."

srcs.episode: DJ SHADOW - Endtroducing... (la música con desechos)

podcast.title: Influence of Manual Desynchronization in the 90s
podcast.body: The distinct sound of sample-based instrumental hip hop in the 1990s was heavily influenced by the manual timing imperfections, or "desacompasamientos," that resulted from artists manually triggering samples. This characteristic, due to the hands-on nature of the technology and the need to adjust timings by ear, became a defining feature of the genre during that decade, exemplified by artists like J Dilla and DJ Shadow. "Y es una de las cosas que yo creo que más ha marcado el sonido del Sample en los 90, esos pequeños desacompasamientos manuales."

srcs.episode: DJ SHADOW - Endtroducing... (la música con desechos)

podcast.title: Influence on Chill Out Diversification
podcast.body: In the first half of the 1990s, as the Chill Out genre began to diversify and incorporate influences from outside rave culture, instrumental hip-hop became a notable source of inspiration. This infusion of new sounds contributed to the genre's expansion and evolution. "cogiendo influencias del ghihop instrumental."
